about_the_game:
Sam was just a regular young man.  Living a regular boring life.   Then one day, it all changed...

En.Fem.E No. 9 - The Factory continues the story of the first game. En,Fem.E No. 9 - Reborn.  Okama Pharmaceuticals, an evil corporation hell bent on turn men into mindless bimbo drones.  They want to develop a formula to easily turn unsuspecting men into big breasted women that will do their bidding.  Will Sam help them achieve their goals?  Or will he... She fight back?  

En.Fem.E No. 9 - The Factory is a game about male to female transformation with a lot of sex along the way.  Its a tale with so many diabolical twists and turns your mouth will be hanging wide open.  Not for that reason you horny boy.  Play it and se for yourself.

En-Fem-E No. 9 is in the style of 80's point and click adventure games.  You will explore, solve puzzles, and battle progressively more difficult bosses to progress the story.

You, Sam start off as a prisoner of an evil pharmaceutical company.  You will have to follow your captures orders and participate in a feminization training regimen if you want to be free.

Once you complete your training they send you out into the world with a mission to help them develop a secret formula. En-Fem-E No. 9,  They base you in a highly guarded company apartment where you receive your missions from your handler.  These missions mostly entail you collecting a "sample" from hand picked subjects.

And to keep you on task and motivated.  They are holding your father, a bio chemist, hostage.  His well being depends on how well you perform the tasks given to you.

If you sabotage their plans, your father is in great danger. But, if you help these evil corporate monsters succeed. It could mean they complete the En-Fem-E No. 9 formula and transform everyone on the planet to their version of an ideal population.  Feminine drones.  Good luck
